intent: Analyze system state baseline for ASUS TUF Gaming A17 laptop
detected_fault: Random Blue Screens (BSOD) with occasional screen freezes, restarts, or shutdowns
suggested_solution: Run a thorough stress test using tools like Prime95, OCCT, or FurMark to identify potential thermal throttling issues.
Update graphics drivers to the latest version (460.58) and ensure compatibility with the system configuration.
Check for any BIOS updates and install the latest version (510).
Monitor system temperatures using software like HWMonitor or GPU-Z to identify potential overheating issues.
Consider running a memory stress test using tools like MemTest86+ to rule out RAM-related issues.
